contact.owner: Katie Congdon (daughter of founders Dan & Frances Junk)
contact.address: 4301 S Congress Ave / Manchaca Rd / North Lamar / Airport Blvd, Austin, TX

colour_palette.details: Landing page relies on flat red and brown PNG background images. No CSS custom properties or tokenized palette. Colors are hardcoded in legacy raster sprite graphics.

logo.details: Logo is embedded inside an animation sprite slice ('dans_logo.png'). Missing standalone web SVG vector asset; favicon is missing.

typography.details: Hardcoded global 'font-family: Arial'. No Google Fonts or custom font loading. Header tags lack visual weight scale.

contact.details: Direct email (info@dans-hamburgers.com), multiple location phone numbers, and well-known family ownership.

online_presence.details: Splash screen uses a 2012 jQuery animation with absolute pixel positioning that redirects to 'dans.php'. Zero mobile responsiveness, broken viewport scaling, and no Schema.org Restaurant markup.

verdict.commercial_rationale: 50+ year local institution with massive goodwill and daily foot traffic, but a completely non-responsive 2012 website. Generating a cinematic, mobile-first burger menu demo will present immense commercial contrast.

sample_website.notes: New edited SmashGuys-based sample for Dan's Hamburgers (F-grade lead). Heritage red/mustard palette + Bebas Neue stack, mobile-first, Schema.org Restaurant + OG/Twitter cards. Local preview verified HTTP 200. Deploy target: preview.wishgranters.com/div0011/dans-hamburgers-proposed.
